materiality: Mistral-Large-3 with yarn.apply_scale=false could be adapted without attention_factor=1.0, selecting deepseek_yarn and applying a spurious yarn magnitude scale despite the model configuration explicitly disabling it.
Upstream classifies the result as an accuracy regression on main, so this is model arithmetic correctness rather than ordinary configuration churn.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact vLLM source/container, Mistral-Large-3 checkpoint/config/tokenizer revisions, Transformers/Torch/CUDA stack and the adapted rope_parameters actually executed.

Run the immediate predecessor as a known-bad control with yarn.apply_scale=false and preserve the adapted config plus selected attention-scaling path; prove the candidate emits attention_factor=1.0 and selects the non-yarn-magnitude path.
Compare short- and long-context logits and a deterministic held-out accuracy/perplexity slice against an independently executed reference; include apply_scale=true as a non-regression control.
Preserve rollback and do not promote the model/runtime from config-unit tests alone.

materiality: DeepSeek-V4 NVIDIA fused-MoE expert ownership was derived from tensor-parallel rank/size instead of the expert-parallel process group, allowing TP and EP layouts to assign physical experts to the wrong ranks.
The successor derives local expert count and start/end indices from the EP group's world size and rank, making distributed topology part of the correctness contract.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact vLLM source/image, DeepSeek-V4 artifact/config, TP/EP/EPLB settings, redundant/shared expert counts, CUDA/NCCL/Torch versions and accelerator topology.

Run predecessor and candidate on a topology where TP size differs from EP size; record rank-to-physical-expert ownership and prove every logical/physical expert is assigned exactly once with no gaps or overlap.
Compare fused-MoE outputs/logits against an independently executed non-fused or otherwise qualified reference across routed/shared experts and redundant-expert settings.
Exercise invalid topology/divisibility, restart/rebalance and rollback before throughput or scaling claims.

materiality: The top-k=1 fused MoE fast path could skip the intermediate reduction buffer even when routed_scaling_factor was non-unit, bypassing the stage that applies requested routed scaling.
The successor forces the intermediate path when scaling is not None/1.0, closing a silent numerical error.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact SGLang source/image, model/checkpoint, MoE backend, dtype/quantization, top-k, routed_scaling_factor, TP/EP topology and accelerator.
Use predecessor negative controls at top-k=1 with multiple non-unit factors and compare candidate outputs against an explicit post-route scaling reference; include top-k>1 and unit-scaling controls.
Exercise LoRA hooks present/absent, fused reduction variants, supported quantized/non-quantized paths and graph/eager execution.
Require finite outputs/logits within declared tolerances and preserve rollback before performance claims.

materiality: mistral_common templates can emit control tokens without a faithful text form; rendering to text and re-encoding could corrupt control tokens and prepend another BOS, so tool_choice=auto never sees the intended tool framing.
The successor probes whether text round-trip is lossy and uses template-produced token IDs directly when safe.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact SGLang source/image, mistral_common/tokenizer package and model/tokenizer revisions, chat-template bytes, tool-schema hash and request settings.

Preserve predecessor render/re-encode and direct-token-id sequences for tool and no-tool prompts; prove candidate chooses IDs only when round-trip is lossy and never double-inserts BOS/control tokens.

Exercise tool_choice auto/required/none where supported, multiple tools, cached/uncached templates, streaming/non-streaming, text and multimodal requests and malformed schemas; compare final model input IDs exactly.
No tool effector may be enabled from prompt/parser qualification alone; downstream selection and arguments retain existing policy/human gates.

materiality: add_weighted_adapter already folds source scaling into merged LoRA weights but inherited use_rslora=true, multiplying an adapter intended to have scale 1 by sqrt(new_rank).
Upstream reports rank-4 norm ratios of 2.0 for linear and about 2.83 for cat before the fix; SVD retains a separate pre-existing double-scaling defect and is not qualified by this successor.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact PEFT/Transformers/Torch revisions, base-model checkpoint, source-adapter hashes/configs, ranks/alphas/use_rslora flags, combination type and dtype.

Run predecessor and candidate for single- and multi-adapter linear/cat composition with deterministic weights; compare delta weights and outputs to an independently computed weighted-composition reference.
Include multiple ranks/non-unit source weights, save/reload/merge/unmerge and a non-rslora control; mark SVD UNQUALIFIED until its separate scaling bug is governed and repaired.
Do not publish/overwrite adapter artifacts until parity, provenance/license and rollback receipts pass.

materiality: Diffusers adds Qwen-Image 2.1 with block-causal text/condition/target attention, reusable prefix KV cache, a 64-channel VAE and image-conditioned generation; the integration fixed multiple correctness and memory defects before merge.
Material merged fixes include exact fallback attention behavior, KV-cache storage ownership, 16x VAE spatial scaling, prompt-mask batching and training-compatible text/image conditioning.
requiredEvidence: Before execution, resolve and record the exact public Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 checkpoint revision/file identities through an allowed primary HF source; if unresolved, keep the lane UNAVAILABLE and do not substitute another Qwen image model.
Bind exact Diffusers source, checkpoint, Qwen3-VL encoder/processor, VAE/transformer subfolders, Torch/CUDA stack, attention processor, dtype, resolution, seed and condition-image hashes.

Compare default segmented attention and compiled flex attention to declared reference tolerances; exercise KV cache on/off, batch 1/>1, multiple prompts/images, num_images_per_prompt>1, condition images, empty prompts, save/load and tiled VAE shape.
Measure memory/throughput only after output/cache correctness; do not mirror weights merely for inventory.

materiality: hf jobs run/uv run and scheduled variants used ignore_unknown_options, allowing --format, --json and -q to leak into the launched Job as script/image arguments instead of being consumed by the CLI.
The successor is deployment argument integrity relevant to automated job orchestration and receipt parsing, not cosmetic output formatting.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact huggingface_hub source/package, hf CLI invocation, namespace identity, test image/script hash and requested output format; use bounded non-secret jobs only.

Run predecessor parser controls proving format flags can alter forwarded image/script arguments, then prove candidate parsing is positionally stable and respects -- when the child script intentionally needs those flags.
Exercise jobs run, jobs uv run, scheduled run and scheduled uv run with human/json/quiet and detached/non-detached modes; never treat successful submission as workload success.
Do not change production schedules/credentials/compute defaults; preserve cancellation and v1.32 rollback until admitted.

materiality: Fast-prefill padding re-dispatched with num_active_loras=0, so an active-LoRA batch could select a different CUDA-graph padding variant from actual model execution and produce mismatched logits-index shapes.
The successor threads active-LoRA count into fast-prefill dispatch and adds token-boundary tests with 1/2/4 active adapters.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact vLLM source/image, base model, every LoRA adapter revision/hash, CUDA-graph mode, num_active_loras, batch/token counts, logits-index geometry and accelerator runtime.

Use predecessor negative controls where a no-LoRA graph pads differently from active-LoRA execution; prove candidate fast-prefill metadata uses the same active-adapter count and token/logit shape as main dispatch.

Exercise token counts around graph-padding boundaries, 1/2/4 active adapters, eager/captured modes, adapter add/remove between batches, cancellation/restart and mixed LoRA/non-LoRA requests; compare with fast prefill disabled.
Retain the non-fast-prefill path as rollback and require adapter/output parity before latency claims.
